data.camera: cowboy shot, walking through a Liberio city street in Marley military uniform
data.description: 【三笠 · 马莱街头】马莱的街巷里，三笠穿着黑色军装制服走在异国的屋檐下，胸甲与束带收束出挺拔的轮廓，红围巾在灰暗的色调中是唯一的亮色——「无论走到哪里，我都会找到你。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa walks beneath the eaves of a Liberio street in her black Marley-era military uniform, breastplate and straps over a white shirt. Her red scarf provides a distinct color within the muted cowboy view. Foreign shopfronts overlap behind her and the lane narrows ahead. Gray overcast light softens the masonry and her stern face, with subdued metal reflections along the armor and darker shelter beneath the projecting roofs.
data.title: 三笠 · 马莱街头
